Plugin.Name: Disk Location Next
Plugin.Overview: Maps your physical drive bays, hot-swap trays, and PCIe NVMe carriers to a visual tray map, with per-drive array/pool role, capacity, manufacturer branding, and SMART health history over time. A ground-up rewrite of the original Disk Location plugin concept, built as a standalone service against Unraid's native unraid-api (Unraid 7.2+) instead of a classic PHP webGUI plugin.
